name: James Lucier

lean.basis: Spent 25 years as a Senate staffer for Republican Sen. Jesse Helms, including as minority staff director of the Foreign Relations Committee; treasurer and director of the national-conservative Edmund Burke Foundation.

sources.title: Edmund Burke Foundation (2022 Form 990 officers) — DeSmog

current_role: Co-founder and managing director of Capital Alpha Partners; treasurer and director of the Edmund Burke Foundation
summary: James Lucier was a Senate staffer for 25 years, most prominently as Jesse Helms's foreign-policy aide and, from 1987, minority staff director of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee. He later spent nine years in Prudential's Washington policy research group and in 2007 co-founded the policy research firm Capital Alpha Partners. He is treasurer and a director of the Edmund Burke Foundation, which runs the NatCon conferences.
